note: What a kind of entity COULD mean in the books, and what would have to be true to choose between the options. Never a single answer where the entity supplies more than one thing — that single answer was the old model, and it is how a fuel brand came to authorise a VAT claim.
how_reasoning_uses_this: possible_treatments is the menu; discriminators are what let engine/reasoning.py pick from it. A type whose menu has one item is MONOLINE — the entity can only supply one thing that matters to the books, so identity settles it and no discriminator is needed. A type with several needs evidence, and if the evidence does not discriminate the row keeps the default and stays in review with the alternatives recorded.
vat_rule: possible_vat is never 'standard'. Recognising an entity does not establish that a valid tax invoice exists, that the supplier is registered, or that the purpose was business. The strongest a type may assert is evidence_required, and Layer 5 turns that into a calculated amount with a withheld claim.

fuel_retailer.label: Fuel Retailer
fuel_retailer.vat_evidence_required: tax invoice; fuel is zero-rated while forecourt goods and car washes are standard-rated, and one statement line cannot tell them apart

discriminators.reason: consistent with refuelling a vehicle rather than buying bulk stock
too large for a single tank; consistent with fuel bought as stock
the business shows other vehicle activity

grocery_retailer.label: Grocery / Supermarket
grocery_retailer.vat_evidence_required: tax invoice and business purpose; supermarkets sell zero-rated food alongside standard-rated goods

pharmacy_retailer.label: Pharmacy
pharmacy_retailer.vat_evidence_required: tax invoice; pharmacies sell exempt medical supplies alongside standard-rated retail goods

food_delivery.label: Food Delivery
food_delivery.vat_evidence_required: business purpose; meals and entertainment are frequently non-deductible

software_vendor.label: Software / Cloud Vendor
software_vendor.vat_evidence_required: tax invoice AND the supplier's South African VAT registration; several of these vendors bill from foreign entities, where there is often no South African input VAT to claim at all

discriminators.reason: an advertising product, not an IT subscription

courier_operator.label: Courier / Freight Operator
courier_operator.vat_evidence_required: tax invoice; freight inwards on stock is a cost of sales rather than an administrative expense

payment_aggregator.label: Payment Aggregator
payment_aggregator.vat_evidence_required: the underlying supplier and its tax invoice; a collection service hides who was actually paid

general_retailer.label: General Retailer
general_retailer.vat_evidence_required: tax invoice and a description of what was bought; a general retailer sells everything

vehicle_telematics.label: Vehicle Tracking / Telematics
vehicle_telematics.monoline_reason: a telematics provider supplies vehicle tracking and nothing else

electricity_utility.label: Electricity Utility
electricity_utility.monoline_reason: an electricity utility supplies electricity and nothing else

insurer.label: Insurer
insurer.monoline_reason: an insurer supplies insurance; premiums are exempt supplies, so there is no input VAT to claim and none to gather evidence for

revenue_authority.label: Revenue Authority
revenue_authority.monoline_reason: SARS collects tax; a payment to it is a statutory settlement, outside the VAT system

professional_services.label: Accounting / Professional Services
professional_services.monoline_reason: the service supplied is professional work; the account does not depend on what was discussed

telecoms_operator.label: Telecommunications Operator
telecoms_operator.monoline_reason: a network operator supplies communications services

toll_operator.label: Toll Operator
toll_operator.monoline_reason: a toll concession supplies road use and nothing else

security_services.label: Security Services
security_services.monoline_reason: an alarm and monitoring company supplies security services
